01 / About

Connecting Finance, Process Excellence and Technology.

My professional focus is to make Finance operations more reliable, transparent and efficient by combining accounting knowledge with process thinking, ERP workflows, automation and analytics.

Finance transformation starts with understanding the process, the people and the controls—before choosing the technology.

My professional journey

I am a Finance & Accounting professional with 12+ years of experience across accounting operations and finance processes, including Record-to-Report (R2R), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, general ledger activities, reconciliations, financial reporting, taxation and ERP-supported workflows.

Through my work, I have developed a practical appreciation for how transaction accuracy, master data, upstream process quality, clear ownership and well-designed controls affect the reliability of financial results. I am especially interested in improving the way Finance teams manage recurring work, resolve exceptions and turn operational information into useful business insight.

Why I built this website

I created this website as a professional space to share my experience, document my learning and demonstrate how Finance knowledge can connect with process improvement and technology. It brings together my professional profile, Finance Process Transformation series, independent portfolio work and educational content in one place.

The projects and demonstrations published here are intended to show my approach to problem-solving. Where examples use illustrative or synthetic data, they are presented as portfolio demonstrations—not as client implementations or claimed business results.

My approach to Finance transformation

  • Understand the current process: map the workflow, hand-offs, data inputs, delays and control points.
  • Define the problem with evidence: measure recurring errors, manual effort, ageing, rework and exception patterns where data is available.
  • Design for control as well as efficiency: preserve approvals, traceability, reconciliation totals, exception handling and human review.
  • Use technology purposefully: explore ERP capabilities, Excel and Power Query, dashboards and automation where they solve a defined problem.
  • Measure and improve: use clear ownership and relevant KPIs to assess whether a change actually helps.

Learning, innovation and collaboration

I continue to build my knowledge in analytics, automation and continuous improvement, and I am developing independent Finance automation concepts to make common accounting tasks easier to review and control. My MBA in Business Analytics supports this interest in connecting business processes with data and practical decision-making.

I value thoughtful collaboration with Finance professionals, recruiters, business owners, accounting firms and technology practitioners. I am interested in opportunities across Finance transformation, R2R and controllership, Finance operations, process excellence, ERP-enabled improvement and carefully scoped project-based work.

Finance Transformation Lab · BRS Automation

Reconciliation, with control built in.

Turn bank and ERP exports into a structured reconciliation review. Match transactions, surface exceptions and download a traceable working file—without sending selected CSV contents to a server in this browser-based prototype.

Try the BRS workspace ↓Explore membership

Prototype notice: exact reference + amount matching only. Not yet a production accounting control or a guarantee of complete reconciliation.

01 · Import

Bring your files

Start with CSV exports from a bank statement and ERP bank book. Validate headers and amount fields before processing.

02 · Reconcile

Match and investigate

Use one-to-one matching by normalized reference and amount. Duplicate, missing or ambiguous records should be investigated—not silently cleared.

03 · Export

Keep a review trail

Download matched and exception rows for review. Compare totals and obtain finance-owner approval before posting or closing.

BRS automation workspace

Upload CSV files with a header row. The prototype reads the selected files in your browser. It does not upload them, and this page does not connect to your bank, ERP or payment provider.

Important limitations: CSV only; exact normalized reference and amount matching; one-to-one matching; no date tolerance, FX, fee logic, split/combined transactions or automatic journal posting. Duplicate references and ambiguous records are exceptions. Always verify row counts, opening/closing balances and totals against source systems. Do not upload employer, customer or other confidential financial data unless you have explicit authorization.
